title: Native tools
notReady: Commands become available after this chat starts a native session. Start a conversation, then refresh this menu.
discoveryUnavailable: The native runtime has not confirmed this list. Refresh to check again.
compactUnavailable: Context compaction is not verified for this runtime.
skillEvidence: Listed skills were discovered by the native engine. Loading is shown only when the engine can confirm it.
connectorEvidence: Connections reported by this native session. Model providers, MCP tools and hosted services have separate capabilities.
restoring: Compaction finished; restoring the current memory view…
completedRestored: Context compacted and current memory view restored.
cancelled: Command cancelled. Check the status before retrying.
stale: This command list has changed. Refresh it before trying again.
executeFailed: Could not complete the native command.
unknownCommand: This command is not available in the current native session. Open Tools to see supported commands.
noAttachments: Native commands do not accept these attachments. Remove the attachments before running the command.
